description: Logical permission packs for Scenario Agent App. Each pack groups delegated permissions needed to enable a coherent set of scenarios. Packs are additive and least-privilege; no pack is a broad wildcard bundle.

packs.name: Mail scenario pack
packs.least_privilege_notes: Mail.Send is the minimum scope required to send mail on behalf of the signed-in user. It does not include Mail.Read or Mail.ReadWrite. The scenario design only sends mail; it does not read or delete mailbox content.
packs.expected_blast_radius: A signed-in user can send mail from their own mailbox. The blast radius is limited to that mailbox plus the recipients specified by the scenario.
packs.consent_impact: Requires new delegated permission grant for the Scenario Agent App. User.Read is not sufficient.

packs.name: Calendar scenario pack
packs.least_privilege_notes: Calendars.ReadWrite is required because scenarios create, update, and delete events in the actor's calendar. Calendars.Read alone is insufficient because the calendar actions require write capability.
packs.expected_blast_radius: A signed-in user can create, update, and delete events in their own calendar. The blast radius is limited to that calendar and the invited attendees.
packs.consent_impact: Requires new delegated permission grant for the Scenario Agent App. User.Read is not sufficient.

packs.name: OneDrive / Files scenario pack
packs.least_privilege_notes: Files.ReadWrite is required because scenarios create, update, and delete files in the actor's OneDrive. Sites.ReadWrite.All is not required because the scenarios only target the actor's own drive.
packs.expected_blast_radius: A signed-in user can create, update, and delete small files in their own OneDrive. The blast radius is limited to that drive.
packs.consent_impact: Requires new delegated permission grant for the Scenario Agent App. User.Read is not sufficient.

packs.name: Teams scenario pack
packs.least_privilege_notes: Reserved for future Teams scenarios. The current catalog does not include a Teams scenario because the G01 read-only inventory does not collect Teams messaging data; observable evidence for a Teams scenario cannot be supported confidently from project evidence.
packs.expected_blast_radius: A signed-in user can send chat and channel messages. The blast radius is the chats and channels that the user is a member of.
packs.consent_impact: Not required for the current catalog. If a future scenario is added, the pack must be reviewed and the app registration amended.
packs.notes: FLAG: No Teams scenario is enabled in the initial catalog. Do not grant this pack until observability evidence is added to the G01 inventory.

packs.name: Authentication observation pack
packs.least_privilege_notes: No additional delegated permissions are required. The sign-in observation scenario is represented as an operator-driven step rather than a programmatic action; observability flows through G01-006 (sign-in logs) which is collected by the Collector App, not the Scenario Agent App.
packs.expected_blast_radius: Operator signs in as a test user. The blast radius is a single interactive sign-in event attributed to the test user.

additive_policy: Packs must be activated one at a time. The Scenario Agent App registration is not modified by this task; pack activation must be performed by a separate, approved task.
notes: No pack contains a broad wildcard scope (e.g. *.ReadWrite.All, Directory.*).
No pack bundles Mail + Calendar + Files permissions together. Each pack is independent.
Current registered Scenario Agent App permissions are User.Read only. Any additional permission listed above is REQUIRED_NOT_GRANTED.
